title: Nurse Corps Tax Parity Act of 2025
latestAction: Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.
summary:
Nurse Corps Tax Parity Act of 2025

This bill excludes from gross income, for federal tax purposes, amounts attributable to Nurse Corps scholarship and loan repayment programs. (The Nurse Corps scholarship and student loan repayment programs are Department of Health and Human Services programs that provide scholarships to and repay student loans of nurses who serve in facilities with a critical shortage of nurses or as faculty at accredited nursing schools.)

actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.
